cards.ex: I only caught a glimpse of the new exhibit; I'll have to go back.
cards.exUz: Men faqat yangi ko'rgazmaning bir qismini ko'rdim; qaytib borishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir qisqa, noaniq tasvirini ko'rish, tezda ko'rib qolish.

cards.ex: The author's novel really fired my imagination.
cards.exUz: Yozuvchining romani haqiqatan ham mening tasavvurimni o't oldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir tasavvurni kuchli ta'sirlantirsa, qiziqish uyg'otsa.

cards.ex: The fever caused her to have hallucinations.
cards.exUz: Isitma uning gallyutsinatsiyalarga duchor bo'lishiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatda mavjud bo'lmagan narsalarni ko'rish, eshitish yoki his qilish.

cards.ex: The artist was often beset by visions that inspired his work.
cards.exUz: Rassom ko'pincha uning ishiga ilhom beruvchi tasavvurlar bilan qurshovda bo'lardi.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy ravishda kuchli tasavvurlar yoki xayollar ta'sirida bo'lish.

cards.ex: His idea of starting a business with no money is just a pipe dream.
cards.exUz: Uning pulisiz biznes boshlash g'oyasi shunchaki amalga oshmas orzu.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan, amalga oshishi qiyin bo'lgan orzu.

cards.ex: Her stories transport you to a realm of imagination where anything is possible.
cards.exUz: Uning hikoyalari sizni har narsa mumkin bo'lgan xayol olamiga olib boradi.
cards.uzDef: Xayoliy, tasavvurga asoslangan dunyo yoki soha.

cards.ex: The concert was so incredible; it felt like a waking fantasy.
cards.exUz: Konsert juda ajoyib edi; bu o'ngdagi xayolga o'xshardi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatga yaqin, ammo xayoliy bo'lgan tasavvur.

cards.ex: Sometimes, I just like to sit and dream a little dream about winning the lottery.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan shunchaki o'tirib, lotereyada yutish haqida kichik orzu qilishni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy, kichik orzularga berilmoq.

cards.ex: He was a visionary leader who transformed the company's approach to innovation.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyaning innovatsiyalar bo'yicha yondashuvini o'zgartirgan dono lider edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakni ko'ra biladigan va yangiliklar yaratadigan rahbar.

cards.ex: The author skillfully weaves a narrative that keeps you hooked from beginning to end.
cards.exUz: Muallif mohirlik bilan hikoya to'qiydi, bu sizni boshidan oxirigacha qiziqtiradi.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani yoki hikoyani tasvirlash yoki yaratish.

cards.ex: She's a creative genius; her paintings are truly breathtaking.
cards.exUz: U ijodkor daho; uning rasmlari haqiqatan ham hayratlanarli.
cards.uzDef: Noyob ijodiy qobiliyatga ega bo'lgan inson.

cards.ex: He still harbors illusions about becoming a famous actor, despite years of rejection.
cards.exUz: Rad etilishlarga qaramay, u hali ham mashhur aktyor bo'lish haqida xom xayollar qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Asossiz umidlarga yoki noto'g'ri tasavvurlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The invention was a spark of genius that revolutionized the industry.
cards.exUz: Ixtiro sanoatni inqilob qilgan daholik alomati edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda paydo bo'lgan ajoyib g'oya yoki qobiliyat.

cards.ex: Her life is a testament to the relentless pursuit of dreams.
cards.exUz: Uning hayoti orzular sari tinimsiz intilishning dalilidir.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadlariga erishish uchun harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Some might say his ambition is an impossible dream, but he's determined to try.
cards.exUz: Ba'zilar uning ambitsiyasi amalga oshmas orzu deyishlari mumkin, lekin u harakat qilishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Erishish qiyin yoki imkonsiz bo'lgan orzu.

cards.ex: Good science fiction should stretch the imagination and make you think about the future.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi ilmiy fantastika xayolni kengaytirishi va sizni kelajak haqida o'ylashga majbur qilishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvurni cheksiz imkoniyatlar sari ochish.

cards.ex: Buying a tropical island is just a flight of fancy for most people.
cards.exUz: Tropik orolni sotib olish ko'pchilik uchun shunchaki xayol parvozi.
cards.uzDef: Asossiz yoki g'alati fikr yoki rejalar.

cards.ex: The art program is designed to foster creativity in young children.
cards.exUz: San'at dasturi yosh bolalarda ijodni rag'batlantirish uchun mo'ljallangan.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy fikrlash va ifodalashni rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: The artist's paintings are an expression of her inner vision.
cards.exUz: Rassomning rasmlari uning ichki ko'rishining ifodasidir.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning ichki dunyosidagi tasavvur va tushunchalar.

cards.ex: She has a remarkable ability to conceptualize complex ideas.
cards.exUz: U murakkab g'oyalarni shakllantirish qobiliyatiga ega.
cards.uzDef: G'oyalarni tushunish va aniq shaklga keltirish.

cards.ex: I can easily lose myself in a good book for hours.
cards.exUz: Men yaxshi kitob o'qishga soatlab berilib ketishim mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga to'liq berilib, o'zini unutish.

cards.ex: The monster under the bed was just a figment of his overactive imagination.
cards.exUz: Krovat ostidagi maxluq uning haddan tashqari faol xayolining mahsuli edi.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvurdan yaratilgan narsa, haqiqat emas.

cards.ex: Visiting museums and art galleries can fuel the imagination.
cards.exUz: Muzeylar va san'at galereyalariga tashrif buyurish xayolni oziqlantirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvurni rivojlantirishga yordam beradigan narsa.

cards.ex: Understanding the creative process can help you overcome writer's block.
cards.exUz: Ijodiy jarayonni tushunish yozuvchining bloklanishini bartaraf etishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi narsani yaratish uchun qilinadigan bosqichlar.

cards.ex: The author paints a vivid picture of life in the 19th century.
cards.exUz: Muallif 19-asr hayotining yorqin tasvirini yaratadi.
cards.uzDef: So'zlar orqali aniq tasvir yaratish.

cards.ex: During childhood, there's often a reign of fantasy, where anything feels possible.
cards.exUz: Bolalik davrida ko'pincha fantaziya hukmronligi bo'ladi, bunda hamma narsa mumkin bo'lib tuyuladi.
cards.uzDef: Tasavvurlarning kuchli ta'siri ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: The team is working hard to dream up innovative solutions to the energy crisis.
cards.exUz: Jamoa energiya inqiroziga innovatsion yechimlar o'ylab topish ustida qattiq ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muammolarni hal qilish uchun yangi g'oyalar yaratish.

cards.ex: Children often have an unbridled imagination that allows them to create amazing stories.
cards.exUz: Bolalarda ko'pincha tizginsiz xayol bo'ladi, bu ularga ajoyib hikoyalar yaratishga imkon beradi.
cards.uzDef: Cheklanmagan, erkin tasavvur.

cards.ex: He was so lost in a daydream that he didn't hear me calling him.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik xayolga cho'mganki, meni chaqirganimni eshitmadi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatdan uzoqlashib, xayollarga berilib ketish.

cards.ex: Listening to music always gets my creative juices flowing.
cards.exUz: Musiqa tinglash doimo mening ijodiy kuchimni uyg'otadi.
cards.uzDef: Ijodiy fikrlash kuchaymoq.
